title: OECD: Each month of lockdown to cost economies 2% of GDP
description: For every month of a shutdown, the OECD says major economies will lose 2 percent of GDP growth. Credit Suisse Chief Economist James Sweeney says that there is a trade-off between shutting the economy down and stopping the coronavirus, and it's more important to do the latter.
